name: This will not go well
storyline:
You are there... alone in a black empty void known as space inside your spaceship... it feels so empty... it feels so calm... but what the heck?

Suddenly a rather annoying alarm in your spaceship starts to emmit a blasting sound and red lights. You put on your fish bowl space helmet and gaze through the main cargo door and in a gasp of horror... oh no!... you are surrounded by missiles that are coming straight at you!

You try to perform evasive actions to avoid all of them. It seems you are a very clumsy astronaut that activated the defence system of a nearby planet, they think you are their enemy! How long would you be able to survive?

It seems to me that... this will not go well...

The goal of this game is simple. You are the spaceship. You have to avoid missiles and make then collide against each other to win points. The more points you make, the better.

A white circle surrounds the spaceship. It indicates the 'Danger zone'. If a hazard is within the 'Danger zone', time is slowed down until there are no hazards inside it.
summary:
In a calm and vast black void, your peaceful journey is abruptly shattered when your spaceship's alarm blares with flashing red lights. Having accidentally triggered a nearby planet's defense system, you find yourself framed as a hostile intruder. Trapped inside your vessel, you must perform desperate, evasive maneuvers to dodge a relentless barrage of incoming homing missiles coming straight for you.

This Will Not Go Well is an intense survival arcade game where you control the spaceship to outmaneuver incoming projectiles. Your objective is simple: survive as long as possible by baiting missiles to collide with one another to score points. When a hazard breaches your ship's surrounding 'Danger Zone', time slows down, giving you a clutch moment of bullet-time focus to dodge fatal impacts and maximize your high score.
